info.name: Skwirrel PIM API v3
info.description:
Skwirrel PIM API, version 3. JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTPS.

- Every call is `POST https://{customer}.skwirrel.eu/jsonrpc` (production) or `https://{customer}.skwirrel.dev/jsonrpc` (dev/test). The method name goes in the request body.
- Send the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Version: 3`. Without it, core answers with the latest version.
- Authenticate with a static token in the header `X-Skwirrel-Api-Token` (default), or with OAuth2 client credentials: `POST /oauth2/token` with `grant_type=client_credentials`, `client_id` and `client_secret`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Access tokens are valid for one hour.
- A Skwirrel administrator grants access per method.

Errors come back as a JSON-RPC `error` object instead of `result`:

| Situation | HTTP | error.code | error.message |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wrong, expired or missing token | 401 | -32001 | Unauthorized |
| No grant for this method | 403 | -32002 | Method is forbidden |
| Too many requests | 429 | -32029 | Too many requests |

**Getting started:** pick the Production or Development environment, set `customer` to your tenant name and the secret `api_token` to your static token.

**OAuth2 instead:** open the collection's Authorization tab, choose OAuth 2.0 (pre-filled with client credentials and the token URL), fill the secrets `client_id` and `client_secret` in the environment, and click Get New Access Token.

request.description:
Retrieve products with optional filtering, pagination and include options

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number (1-based) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results per page (1–1000) |
| `filter` | object (nullable) | no | Filter criteria: dynamic_selection_id, product_status_id, manufacturer_id, brand_id, code, updated_on |
| `options` | object (nullable) | no | Include options: include_trade_items, include_etim, include_custom_classes, include_categories, include_languages, etc. |

**Example: First page of products**. Use include_* flags to expand trade items, attachments, ETIM data, and more.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "getProducts",
  "params": {
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 2
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "products": [
    {
      "product_id": 1,
      "internal_product_code": "ART001",
      "manufacturer_product_code": "MFR-001",
      "product_erp_description": "Product one"
    },
    {
      "product_id": 2,
      "internal_product_code": "ART002",
      "manufacturer_product_code": "MFR-002",
      "product_erp_description": "Product two"
    }
  ],
  "page": {
    "number_of_items": 2,
    "items_per_page": 2,
    "number_of_pages": 1,
    "current_page": 1
  }
}
```

Alias of getProducts, kept for backward compatibility with v2 integrations

No parameters.

| `product_id` | integer[] | yes | Product IDs to check for selection membership |

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "checkProductsInSelection",
  "params": {

    "product_id": [

```

Result:

```json
  "in_selection": [
    1,
    2,
    3
  ],
  "not_in_selection": [
    4
  ]

```

Create or update a product. Set add_to_changes=true to propose an update to an existing product. Returns outcome=applied, queued_for_review (with change_request_id), or no_changes. Review-only clients always queue updates and cannot create products.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `add_to_changes` | boolean | no | Queue an update for review instead of publishing; existing entities only |
| `product_id` | integer (nullable) | no | Internal ID of the product; omit to create a new product |
| `product_type` | string (nullable) | no | Product type: REGULAR, TRADE_ITEM, VIRTUAL, or GROUPED |
| `product_kind` | string (nullable) | no | Product kind: PHYSICAL, DIGITAL, or SERVICE |
| `external_product_id` | string (nullable) | no | Your system's reference ID for the product |
| `product_status_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the publication status to assign |
| `product_start_date` | string (nullable) | no | Date from which the product is available (ISO 8601) |
| `internal_product_code` | string (nullable) | no | Internal article code |
| `manufacturer_product_code` | string (nullable) | no | Manufacturer's own article code |
| `product_gtin` | string (nullable) | no | Global Trade Item Number (GTIN, up to 14 digits) |
| `product_erp_description` | string (nullable) | no | Short ERP system description |
| `product_url` | string (nullable) | no | URL of the product on the manufacturer's website |
| `manufacturer_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the manufacturer |
| `brand_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the brand |
| `product_allowance_group_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the allowance group |
| `product_buying_group_id` | integer (nullable) | no | ID of the buying group |
| `product_weight` | number (nullable) | no | Product weight |
| `product_weight_uom` | string (nullable) | no | Unit of measurement for weight (e.g. KGM, GRM) |
| `product_width` | number (nullable) | no | Product width |
| `product_height` | number (nullable) | no | Product height |
| `product_depth` | number (nullable) | no | Product depth |
| `product_dimension_uom` | string (nullable) | no | Unit of measurement for dimensions (e.g. MMT, CMT) |
| `product_volume` | number (nullable) | no | Product volume |
| `product_volume_uom` | string (nullable) | no | Unit of measurement for volume (e.g. MLT, LTR) |
| `cbs_number` | string (nullable) | no | CBS (Statistics Netherlands) product classification code |
| `unspsc` | string (nullable) | no | UNSPSC product classification code |
| `taric_code` | string (nullable) | no | EU customs tariff (TARIC) code |

**Example: Create a product**. Omit product_id to create; provide it to update an existing product.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "saveProduct",
  "params": {
    "manufacturer_product_code": "MFR-001",
    "internal_product_code": "ART001",
    "product_erp_description": "My product"
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "product_id": 123,
  "outcome": "applied",
  "change_request_id": null
}
```

**Example: Propose a product edit**. Requires review before publication. Unchanged submitted fields preserve earlier pending proposals. A no-op returns outcome=no_changes and change_request_id=null.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "saveProduct",
  "params": {
    "product_id": 123,
    "product_erp_description": "Updated description",
    "add_to_changes": true
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "product_id": 123,
  "outcome": "queued_for_review",
  "change_request_id": 42
}
```

Create or update a product's legislation data (ETIM xChange Legislation block). Any array field provided (hazard_class, _svhc_identification, etc.) replaces the full existing set for that sub-resource; an omitted field is left untouched, an empty array clears it. A scalar field (weee_category, reach_date, ...) is left untouched when omitted, and cleared when explicitly sent as null.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer | yes | Internal ID of the product to save legislation data for |
| `electric_component_contained` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if the product contains electric components |
| `battery_contained` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if the product contains batteries |
| `weee_category` | string (nullable) | no | WEEE category |
| `rohs_indicator` | string (nullable) | no | RoHS indicator |
| `rohs_exemption_number` | string (nullable) | no | RoHS exemption number |
| `ce_marking` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if the product bears the CE marking |
| `sds_indicator` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if a Safety Data Sheet is available |
| `reach_indicator` | string (nullable) | no | REACH indicator |
| `reach_date` | string (nullable) | no | REACH date (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `scip_number` | string (nullable) | no | SCIP number (exactly 36 characters) |
| `ufi_code` | string (nullable) | no | UFI code (e.g. XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) |
| `_svhc_identification` | object[] (nullable) | no | SVHC identifications — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `classification_code` | string (nullable) | no | Classification code |
| `signal_word` | string (nullable) | no | Signal word |
| `environmental_hazards` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if the product has environmental hazards |
| `hazard_class` | string[] (nullable) | no | Hazard classes (xChange HazardClass) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `hazard_label` | string[] (nullable) | no | Hazard labels (xChange HazardLabel, 1-3 characters each) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `label_code` | string[] (nullable) | no | GHS label codes (xChange LabelCode) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `hazard_statement` | string[] (nullable) | no | Hazard statements (xChange HazardStatement, 4-6 characters each, e.g. H319) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `precautionary_statement` | string[] (nullable) | no | Precautionary statements (xChange PrecautionaryStatement, e.g. P305) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `un_number` | string (nullable) | no | UN number (4 digits) |
| `special_provision_id` | string[] (nullable) | no | Special provision IDs (xChange SpecialProvisionId, e.g. SP123) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `adr_category` | string (nullable) | no | ADR category |
| `net_weight_hazardous_substances` | string (nullable) | no | Net weight of hazardous substances |
| `volume_hazardous_substances` | string (nullable) | no | Volume of hazardous substances |
| `_un_shipping_name` | object[] (nullable) | no | UN shipping names — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `packing_group` | string (nullable) | no | Packing group |
| `limited_quantities` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if limited quantities apply |
| `excepted_quantities` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if excepted quantities apply |
| `aggregation_state` | string (nullable) | no | Aggregation state |
| `tunnel_code` | string (nullable) | no | Tunnel code |
| `nos_274` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if NOS 274 applies |
| `hazard_trigger` | string[] (nullable) | no | Hazard triggers (xChange HazardTrigger, 1-100 characters each) — replaces the full existing set for this product when provided |
| `li_ion_tested` | boolean (nullable) | no | True if Li-ion tested |
| `lithium_amount` | string (nullable) | no | Lithium amount (grams) |
| `battery_energy` | string (nullable) | no | Battery energy |
| `eprel_registration_number` | string (nullable) | no | EPREL registration number |

**Example: Set RoHS/WEEE fields, hazard codes, and SVHC identification**

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "saveProductLegislation",
  "params": {
    "product_id": 123,
    "weee_category": "1",
    "rohs_indicator": "true",
    "hazard_class": [
      "1",
      "2.1"
    ],
    "_svhc_identification": [
      {
        "cas_number": "1234567-89-0",
        "ec_number": "123-456-7"
      }
    ]
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "product_id": 123
}
```

Set a custom classification feature value for a product. The class, feature, and value (for types A and M) are created on the fly if they do not exist. For type M, values are appended to existing ones. Setting not_applicable=true wipes the current value.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | integer (nullable) | no | Internal product ID; mutually exclusive with external_product_id |
| `external_product_id` | string (nullable) | no | External product ID; mutually exclusive with product_id |
| `custom_class_code` | string | yes | Code of the custom class to classify under |
| `custom_feature_code` | string | yes | Code of the custom feature |
| `custom_feature_type` | string | yes | Feature type: A (alphanumeric), L (logical), N (numeric), R (range), T (text), B (big-text), D (date), M (multi-value), I (translated text) |
| `custom_value_code` | string (nullable) | no | Custom value code; required for type A and M |
| `numeric_value` | number (nullable) | no | Numeric value; required for type N |
| `logical_value` | boolean (nullable) | no | Logical value; required for type L |
| `range_min` | number (nullable) | no | Range minimum; required together with or instead of range_max for type R |
| `range_max` | number (nullable) | no | Range maximum; required together with or instead of range_min for type R |
| `text_value` | string (nullable) | no | Text value; required for type T |
| `big_text_value` | string (nullable) | no | Big text value; required for type B |
| `translated_text` | string (nullable) | no | Translated text value; required for type I |
| `translated_text_language` | string (nullable) | no | Language code for the translated text; required for type I |
| `date_value` | string (nullable) | no | Date value in YYYY-MM-DD format; required for type D |
| `not_applicable` | boolean (nullable) | no | Set to true to mark the feature as not applicable |

**Example: Set a numeric product feature**. Custom class, feature, and value are created automatically if they do not exist.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "saveSimpleProductFeature",
  "params": {
    "product_id": 123,
    "custom_class_code": "LOGISTICS",
    "custom_feature_code": "WEIGHT_NET",
    "custom_feature_type": "N",
    "numeric_value": 0.5
  },
  "id": 1
}
```

Result:

```json
{
  "custom_class_id": 1,
  "custom_feature_id": 5,
  "custom_class_feature_id": 8,
  "custom_classification_id": 201,
  "custom_value_id": null
}
```

Retrieve trade items

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | integer | no | Page number (1-based) |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of results per page (1–1000) |
| `trade_item_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Filter by internal trade item IDs |
| `product_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Filter by product IDs that own the trade items |
| `external_trade_item_id` | string[] (nullable) | no | Filter by your system's reference IDs for trade items |
| `include_trade_item_status` | boolean | no | Include trade item status fields |
| `include_trade_item_translations` | boolean | no | Include translated trade item names; requires include_languages |
| `include_trade_item_prices` | boolean | no | Include price data for trade items |
| `include_price_list_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Only include prices from these price list IDs; omit to include all |
| `include_prices_from_date` | string (nullable) | no | Only include prices valid from this date (format: YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `include_future_prices` | boolean | no | Also include future prices when using include_prices_from_date |
| `include_trade_item_discounts` | boolean | no | Include discount data for trade items |
| `include_trade_item_vat` | boolean | no | Include VAT rate data for trade items |
| `include_trade_item_charges` | boolean | no | Include surcharge/charge data for trade items |
| `include_trade_item_groups` | boolean | no | Include product group memberships for trade items |
| `include_related_trade_items` | boolean | no | Include related (linked) trade items |
| `include_trade_item_custom_classes` | boolean | no | Include custom classification data for trade items |
| `include_trade_item_custom_class_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Only include custom classes with these IDs |
| `include_trade_item_custom_collection_id` | integer[] (nullable) | no | Only include custom classes from these collection IDs |
| `include_etim` | boolean | no | Include ETIM classification data for trade items |

Set a custom classification feature value for an attachment. The value belongs to the attachment itself, so it is shared by every product the attachment is linked to. | `numeric_value` | number (nullable) | no | Numeric value; required for type N |
| `logical_value` | boolean (nullable) | no | Logical value; required for type L |
| `range_min` | number (nullable) | no | Range minimum; required together with or instead of range_max for type R |
| `range_max` | number (nullable) | no | Range maximum; required together with or instead of range_min for type R |
| `text_value` | string (nullable) | no | Text value; required for type T |

| `external_web_hook_id` | string (nullable) | no | Your system's reference ID for the webhook |
| `web_hook_url` | string (nullable) | no | HTTPS URL that will receive webhook POST requests |
| `web_hook_headers` | object[] (nullable) | no | Custom HTTP headers to include in webhook requests |
| `auth_type` | string (nullable) | no | HTTP authentication type: DIGEST, BASIC, or NTLM |
| `username` | string (nullable) | no | Username for HTTP authentication |
| `password` | string (nullable) | no | Password for HTTP authentication |
| `entity_names` | string[] (nullable) | no | Entity types that trigger this webhook (e.g. product, brand) |
| `is_active` | boolean (nullable) | no | True to enable the webhook; false to pause delivery |

**Example: Register a webhook**. Use external_web_hook_id to upsert; the same call creates or updates the webhook.

```json
    "web_hook_url": "https://example.com/hook",

  },
  "id": 1
}
```
